goal: Design the next standalone BGE-M3 student attempt as validation-aware curriculum distillation rather than another blind scale-up of v66/v67.

fresh_sources_checked.implication: The student must preserve BGE-M3's dense, sparse, and multi-vector retrieval modes; dense-only training is not a credible path to a standalone BGE-M3-derived retriever.
BGE-M3 itself uses self-knowledge distillation across retrieval functionalities, supporting a multi-mode student objective rather than a single dense loss.
Official finetuning supports teacher scores, m3_kd_loss, unified_finetuning, and temperature controls, so the next experiment can stay on the official no-DDP path.
The implementation exposes dense, sparse, and ColBERT losses and score fusion; diagnostics must test both model-card weights and best-vs-best fusion.

fresh_sources_checked.source: Curriculum Learning for Dense Retrieval Distillation
fresh_sources_checked.implication: Difficulty-controlled distillation is a plausible response to v66 being too adversarial and v67 being too narrow.

fresh_sources_checked.source: Beyond Hard Negatives: The Importance of Score Distribution in Knowledge Distillation for Dense Retrieval
fresh_sources_checked.implication: The curriculum should preserve teacher score variance and entropy rather than overfitting only top hard negatives.

fresh_sources_checked.source: ADAM: Dense Retrieval Distillation with Adaptive Dark Examples
fresh_sources_checked.implication: Rows should be filtered by teacher confidence and not all hard examples should be treated as equally useful.

script_update.change: Add --max-best-margin so curriculum stages can target bounded best-margin bands, not only min-margin filters.

v68_curriculum_plan.objective: official FlagEmbedding M3 unified teacher-score distillation

stages.name: v68a-boundary-hard-clean
stages.purpose: Start with qrel-consistent borderline rows so the student sees hard examples without v66-style contradictory teacher targets.
stages.expected_effect: Improve dense+sparse or sparse+ColBERT surfaces without damaging the ColBERT-heavy base-best surface.

stages.name: v68b-middle-score-spectrum
stages.purpose: Add middle teacher margins to recover score-distribution variance that v67 lacks.
stages.expected_effect: Teach smoother ranking preferences and reduce over-specialization to only near-tie hard negatives.

stages.name: v68c-broad-anchor
stages.purpose: Add easy anchors after hard/middle stages to preserve the original BGE-M3 hybrid ordering and avoid sparse-head drift.
stages.expected_effect: Regularize toward stable model-card and ColBERT-heavy surfaces after the student has seen harder rows.

decision.reason: v66/v67 show localized gains but no robust best-vs-best standalone improvement. v68 needs bounded margin-band split generation and a staged training command plan before GPU use.
decision.next_action: Generate v68a/v68b/v68c split summaries on the remote host, inspect their entropy/margin coverage, then launch only the smallest staged smoke if the generated split distributions match the plan.
